 Order

This appeal under Section 173(2) of the Motor Vehicle Act has been preferred feeling aggrieved by the award dated 25.07.2017 in M.C.C.No.95/2015 by Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Betul for enhancement of Rs.1,50,000/-.

2. Appellant Kishore aged 16 years filed claim for personal injuries occurred on 25th January, 2012 at Bhopal - Nagpur N.H.No.69 by Motor Cycle Vehicle No.MP-48-MB-1601 owned by respondent No.2 Bhaurao and driven by respondent No.1 Omprakash and insured by Respondent No.3 New India Insurance Company Ltd. claiming 40% permanent disability.
3. Respondent No.3 contested the claim.

4. Tribunal awarded Rs.40,500/- in the head of loss of future income estimating the 15% permanent Kishore vs Omprakash on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192432516/
1 disability and assessing the income of appellant Rs.15,000/- per annum, Rs.60535/- in the head of Medical Expenses and Rs.5,000/- for loss of income during treatment with interest @ 6% from the date of application i.e, 5th September, 2012.
5. This appeal has been preferred for enhancement of Rs.1,50,000/- on the ground that physical disability is assessed on lower side.
Income is also taken on lower side.
No amount has been awarded in the head of attendant, special diet, transport.
Medical expenses has not been taken into consideration to the full extent.

6. Heard.
7.
Learned counsel for respondent No.3 opposed the prayer.

8. Perused the record.
9.
Tribunal has estimated the age of appellant 16 years.

In para 13 of the award, 1' shortening of the leg and Mal-union is reported by Dr. Prashant Shelke, PW2.
10.
No amount has been awarded in the head of attendant, special diet and transport expenses.
The appellant is entitled for Rs.15,000/- as attendant expenses, Rs.15,000/- as special diet during treatment and Rs.15,000/- for transport expenses.
Thus, an amount of Rs.45,000/- towards compensation is allowed under these three heads.
11. Tribunal in para-21 of the award has granted Rs.5,000/- for loss of earning for a month during treatment.
So loss of dependency has to be enhanced.
Accordingly, appellant is entitled for enhancement of Rs.1,05,000/- (One Lakh Five Thousand) in the head of loss of future income.

12. This appeal is allowed and an amount of Rs.1,50,000/- (One Lakh Fifty Thousand only)
(Rs.45,000/- Rs.1,05,000/-) is enhanced in the compensation amount awarded by the Tribunal to the appellant.
Interest @ 6% per month from the date of application i.e. 05.09.2012 shall also be paid to the appellant/claimant.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE veni Kishore vs Omprakash on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192432516/
